hypothesis: The input hook is not the UI thread, so model work must be deferred to the paint hook

notes: CHOP only schedules a page switch, so it cannot be followed by a poll in the same callback. Phases with 3000 ms / 150 ms deadlines, sample-identity cancellation, atomic flag, input suppression in read()

hypothesis: Direct field writes plus a forced rebuild are the right way to apply a chop
test: Compare the field-poke recipe with the native Reset/Insert/Reconcile API
notes: Both produce the same boundaries, but the native API owns allocation, destruction, listener links and broadcasts, so no vector shortening, synthetic splits or CHOP toggle are needed
